public.title: Diameter of Binary Tree
public.description: Return the maximum number of edges on a path between any two nodes. The path may avoid the root; the empty tree has diameter zero. Trees use compact breadth-first arrays: read the root, then left and right child slots for each non-null node in queue order. null marks a missing child; absent trailing slots are null. [] is empty. Values are integers from -10000 to 10000 and there are at most 200 nodes.
hints: A path through a node uses one downward branch from each side.
Compute subtree heights while maintaining the best combined length.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026, for a standard algorithmic problem. No third-party exercise text or solution code used.

explanation: Postorder traversal computes heights; each left-height plus right-height is a candidate path in edges. O(n) time and O(h) call space.
